title.narrative: Establishment of the physical infrastructure of the Sustainable Island Solutions through Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (SISSTEM) faculty at the University of Aruba.

description.narrative: Laboratory space, classroom space and office space will need to be provided for teaching and research purposes,The Maria Convent building owned by the Government, which is adjacent to the University is suitable for this purpose and is available for renovation and refurbishment, has been made available for the SISSTEM/UA..UNDP was selected to manage the physical set-up of the SISSTEM Faculty, through the renovation/refurbishing of the Maria Covent building and procurement and instalment of laboratories and multifunctional classrooms.

description.narrative: Keywords: AID.LCM.406593.02-2 -
Keywords: AID.LCM.406593.02-2 -

As part of this project a communications and visibility plan were developed to ensure that appropriate visibility is given to the project and that the projects objectives and progress are accurately communicated in Aruba and abroad.For this project, the objective for the SISSTEM Communication and Visibility Plan is to broadly demonstrate progress and impact of EU Support. Specifically, to: End Beneficiaries, with the objective of being informed of the main objectives, progress, and outcomes of the project, as well as the EU support Opinion Makers (media, key influencing people in the communities, parliamentarians, CSOs), with the objective of being informed of the context, result areas and activities for the project, as well as EU support in the sector Key Stakeholders (national & International), to be informed of key results and the impact of the EU support together with the successes and best practices emanating from the project Development community and donors with the intention of highlighting key achievements of the project made possible through the support of the EU.The list of communication activities include:Visibility/completion ceremonies are organized for each completed project phase in agreement with the EU and project stakeholders (including organisation and venue logistics, equipments rental, participants transportation, translation, and catering) Issuance of a press release at the launch and completion of the work and its dissemination through media, UNDP and EU websites and social media Production and dissemination of project updates through websites and social media of implementing partners and EU Production and dissemination of factsheets, leaflets, brochure et similar during projects events and through the websites of all implementing partnersCollection of highresolution images for use with public information material Adhoc social media campaigns and/or events are organized to mark important international Days that are relevant to the project activities.
The different communication activities undertaken that give appropriate visibility to the project audience in Aruba and abroad.

comment.narrative: UNDP will monitor and report on the implementation of the Communication and Visibility plan under its regular reporting requirements to the EU foreseen in the Contribution Agreement.

UNDP hosted gladly a visibility groundbreaking ceremony this occasion included a press release and highresolution imagery httpswww.undp.orgtrinidadandtobagosisstemgroundbreakingceremonyuniversityaruba

description.narrative: Maria Convent Building renovated/refurbished to house the new SISSTEM Facility at the University of Aruba. Ongoing. Construction Project is currently being implemented after the second tender was successful.

Engineering and architectural designs prepared by the Architect Designer (or Design and Supervision firm), contracted by UNDP, for renovation and construction of the Maria Convent building complex to house the SISSTEM Faculty and approved by the SISSTEM Project Board.

comment.narrative: The initial design was planned for 2 prefabricated labs. In September 2020 it was advised by the architect designer and then endorsed by the Project Board that the laboratories are best built new in 1 building named Tera Nobo laboratories TN labs resulting in cost savings.The laboraties have been removed from the scope of the project as additional cost savings were necessary during the retender of the construction works. This is reflected in the Contribution Agreement Addendum 1.

The final design prepared by the Architect Designer was finalized and approved by the Project Board PB members in October 2020. title.narrative: Effective and Efficient Management of the Project

description.narrative: The project is being implemented by UNDP following the Direct Project Management (DIM) modality. The project will be located in Aruba and an office is expected to be established at the University of Aruba (UA). Supervisory, financial and operational support will be provided by a Project Manager (PM) based in Aruba, with support of a national Project Assitant (based in Aruba), a consultant Engineer and the UNDP Office in Trinidad and Tobago.

title.narrative: Successful establishment of Aruba Project Office (APO)

description.narrative: The Aruba Project Office (APO) will be created for the implementation of the SISSTEM project. It comprises relevant personnel of UNDP Trinidad and Tobago Country Office who will carry out various tasks including technical assistance, administration, and management, specifically dedicated to the implementation of this action. The APO is comprised of fulltime dedicated project personnel and parttime specialized project personnel to technically contribute to various project components and activities.a. Project Manager (PM): Responsible for daytoday management of the project including timely and efficient delivery of the projects technical, operational, financial, and administrative outputs.b. Part time Consultant Engineer: Responsible for Quality Assurance/Control guidance of design, construction, and refurbishment work; guidance on technical aspects of RFPs and TORs. c. Project Assistant (PA) based in Aruba will be hired full time and will be responsible for daytoday project and administration support at field level to the PM and other field staff as relevant. Additionally, the UNDP Country Office (CO) in Trinidad and Tobago is directly involved in the implementation of this Action by supporting the implementation through a few specialist personnel. These persons will also be part of the APO.

comment.narrative: The UNDP Aruba Project Office APO was created for the implementation of this project comprising of the UNDP Project Manager Dec 2019 the UNDP Project Assistant Jan 2021 and a Consulting Engineer Jan 2020 with support from relevant personnel of UNDP Trinidad and Tobago Country Office.The proper functioning of the Aruba Project Office was ensured by providing the office and Aruba staff with IT equipment laptops phone printerscanner and stationery materials in January 2020.

The project will be located in Aruba and an office is expected to be established at the University of Aruba (UA). The PM represents UNDPs Trinidad and Tobago Country Office (TTCO) and serves as the Head of UNDPs SISSTEM Faculty Expansion Project Team in Aruba. He/she is responsible for the overall execution of the Project. The SISSTEM PM ensures the effective and efficient day to day management of the project under the overall guidance of the Project Board. The SISSTEM PM is responsible for the overall implementation of all project activities including project inception activities, project planning and reporting, project implementation, monitoring and management of risks, managing stakeholder relationships, supporting project reviews and audits, and conducting project closure activities.

comment.narrative: The SISSTEM PM was initially recruited in Dec 2019. He left the project in Aug 2021 and a new PM was recruited and onboarded in the same month therefore this objective has been met.
